items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: We got as far as Indianapolis. And Eddy Green was on this show. He was one of our first-class comedians.

ctx.x: And all of this weight falls on you, because you can't put them out.
Well, anyhow, that's what happened, anyhow, so they all got other job, see? They eventually got jobs.
